title: Feature Superposition in Neural Networks: From Theory to Practice
abstract: arXiv:2609.06862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Superposition refers to neural networks representing more features than they have dimensions. It offers a possible explanation for polysemantic neurons and motivates methods for recovering interpretable features from neural activations. Theoretical models typically start with a given set of input features and assumptions about how their values vary across inputs, then study how a network encodes those values in a lower-dimensional hidden representation. Empirical work, by contrast, seeks to identify the features encoded in trained networks and determine their role in computation. In this survey, we review the geometry, learning, and computation of superposed representations, explaining how feature statistics and decoder choice affect the conclusions. To connect these theoretical accounts with evidence from trained networks, we compare practical methods for recovering and analyzing features and examine what their evaluations establish. Si

translated_title: 神经网络中的特征叠加：从理论到实践
translated_abstract: 叠加是指神经网络所表示的特征数量超过其自身维度的现象。它为多义神经元提供了一种可能的解释，并推动了从神经激活中恢复可解释特征的方法的发展。理论模型通常从给定的一组输入特征以及关于这些特征值在不同输入间如何变化的假设出发，进而研究网络如何将这些值编码到低维的隐藏表示中。相比之下，实证工作旨在识别训练后的网络中所编码的特征，并确定它们在计算中的作用。在这篇综述中，我们回顾了叠加表示的几何结构、学习过程和计算方式，并解释了特征统计特性与解码器选择如何影响研究结论。为了将这些理论解释与训练网络中的证据联系起来，我们比较了恢复和分析特征的实用方法，并考察了这些方法的评估所能确立的内容。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了神经网络中特征叠加的几何、学习与计算理论，并比较了从训练网络中恢复可解释特征的实用方法及其评估标准，从而将理论研究与实证证据连接起来。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews the geometry, learning, and computation of feature superposition in neural networks and compares practical methods for recovering interpretable features from trained networks, bridging theoretical accounts with empirical evidence.
